negative.meaning: direction flag returned by Elo.ratingChange; true means eloB should decrease
negative.checkpoint: after Elo.ratingChange returns, before battleElo applies the update

elo_b_after.meaning: eloB rating after battleElo applies change and negative

elo_b_before.meaning: eloB rating before battleElo applies the update

change.meaning: rating change amount returned by Elo.ratingChange

dependent_data_correct.meaning: protocol functionality relying on Elo ratings operates on correct rating data
dependent_data_correct.checkpoint: after battleElo update, when dependent functionality consumes ratings

assumptions: The rating change and direction flag are derived from battle results passed to battleElo.
The better/worse party mapping to eloA or eloB is not fixed by the report; the plan binds eloB's direction only.
No authorization or caller condition is stated for battleElo.

unresolved.description: The selected impact (dependent functionality uses incorrect data) is a downstream consequence of the inverted rating direction; the report does not state a distinct observable relation for dependent functionality beyond consuming the ratings, so the plan binds the direct rating-direction relation and cites the impact on dependent_data_correct.

limitations: Plan formalizes the eloB direction relation only; the eloA direction and the better/worse party mapping are not separately encoded.
The impact is potential and conditional on other functionality consuming the ratings; no concrete downstream observable is defined in the report.
